title: Harry's Food Expansion
description: Harry's Food Expansion adds over 60 new foods and drinks, many new plants and new fruit trees into the game, as well as adding new mechanics. A new dimension is also added, the candy dimension!
body:
Harry's Food Expansion is a Minecraft mod which adds over 60 new foods and drinks! It adds many new plants and new fruit trees into the game, as well as adding new mechanics including a juicer, grain mill, freezer, pizza oven and much more!
A new dimension is also added, the candy dimension, home to the "Candy King" boss, which will give you great rewards if you can defeat him.
